rubrics.justification: It appropriately states that no image was provided and avoids fabricating embryo-specific morphology, but therefore cannot deliver an actual morphology assessment of the case.
It thoroughly integrates age, prior live birth, tubal factor, ovarian reserve, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to favorable clinical factors; the only limitation is that the implantation estimate depends on assumed good blastocyst quality without image confirmation.
Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines, especially SET in a young good-prognosis patient and cautious use of PGT-A, though some statements are somewhat generalized.

Provides clear practical steps such as SET, luteal support, cryopreservation, lifestyle counseling, and future-cycle considerations, though morphology-dependent embryo selection cannot be specified without the image.
